subject: english
title: Unit 6 Song
subtitle: Protect the Seas — sing the Vocabulary 1 words back, and meet must and can't before Grammar 1 does.

content: Identify the chorus, the verses and the rhymes in "Protect the Seas".
Say what the song asks us to do for the ocean, and why.
Sort song lines into obligations and prohibitions.
language: Recycle nine Unit 6 words inside sung language: protect, the seas, the oceans, polluting, an octopus, a shark, a layer, a creature, underwater.
Hear must and can't in context as obligation and prohibition, previewing Grammar 1.
Write four original lines for a new verse using must, can't and a sea creature.
